editor.title: Pico Link
editor.description: **{count} configured Picos.** Select a Pico below to edit it. Changes take effect when you select **Save changes**.

method.title: Configuration method
method.description: UI is recommended for new installations. Existing YAML continues working until you explicitly import and save. To keep file-based configuration, choose YAML and set config_method: yaml under pico_link in your configuration.

add.title: Add Pico
add.description: Choose a remote already registered by Lutron Caséta. Automatic reads its stored model. Choose a layout explicitly only when necessary.

identity.title: Remote and button layout
identity.description: Choose the registered Pico and its layout. Existing actions are preserved. If you change the layout, adjust any actions for buttons that are no longer present before saving.

confirm_remove.title: Remove {remote}?
confirm_remove.description: Continue to remove this Pico from the draft. Select Save changes afterward to apply the removal.

remote.title: Configure Pico
remote.description: **{remote}** — layout: {model}. Select **Keep Pico changes** when finished, then **Save changes** to apply them.

assignment.title: What this Pico controls
assignment.description: Choose one kind of device. A Pico can control several entities of that kind.

entities.title: Choose controlled entities
entities.description: These entities receive the normal button commands and are used by action shortcuts such as lights or covers.

button.title: Button actions
button.description: Choose the physical button and gesture to customize. A custom hold runs once; double tap adds a waiting window to single tap.

behavior.title: {gesture}
behavior.description: Normal / inherited removes the local override. Custom actions replace only this gesture. Do nothing disables it. Shared Stop actions require an explicit selection for each gesture.

actions.title: {gesture}
actions.description: Build the sequence with Home Assistant’s action editor. Conditions, delays, loops and script calls are supported. Continue on error belongs to each action. For shortcuts such as lights, use the editor’s YAML view. Shared Stop sequences are used only by Picos that select them.

done.title: Review Pico settings
done.description:
{detail}

Continue to return to this Pico and correct its settings.

defaults.title: Shared defaults
defaults.description: Timing and device settings apply where a Pico has no local override. Shared Stop actions apply only where that gesture explicitly selects the shared action.

shared_stop.title: Shared Stop actions
shared_stop.description: Choose which Stop gesture to define. An empty action list does nothing. Existing middle-button defaults remain supported.

timing.title: Button timing
timing.description: Leave a field empty to inherit its default; clear an existing value to remove its override. Inherited values: {inherited}.

device_settings.title: Device settings
device_settings.description: Leave a field empty to inherit its default; clear an existing value to remove its override. Inherited values: {inherited}.

shared_settings.title: Device defaults
shared_settings.description: Leave a field empty to inherit its default; clear an existing value to remove its override. Inherited values: {inherited}.

run.title: Run behavior
run.description: This policy covers custom actions across all buttons on this Pico. Single ignores a new sequence while busy; restart replaces unfinished work; queued waits; parallel runs alongside it. The limit includes active and waiting sequences in queued mode and active sequences in parallel mode. Silent suppresses rejection warnings. Inherited settings: {inherited}. Leave the limit empty to inherit it. Normal device controls retain their timing.

save.title: Apply settings
save.description: This draft contains {count} Pico remote(s). Saving makes the UI the configuration source and reloads Pico Link without restarting Home Assistant. Running Pico actions will stop during reload. Leftover Pico Link YAML will be ignored. {detail}

import_yaml.title: Import existing YAML?
import_yaml.description: Your current YAML keeps working until you save. Continue to copy its shared defaults, remotes and actions into this editor. After saving, Pico Link uses these UI settings, stored by Home Assistant; the YAML file is not edited. Cancel to keep using YAML. {detail}

workspace.title: Open your Pico Link workspace
workspace.description: Ready to save {count} remotes. Submit to finish setup, then open **Pico Link** in the sidebar or select **Configure** on this integration. The workspace has a searchable list, a visual button editor, and shared defaults. Imported YAML remains in its file; UI settings become active after this step.

error.positive_integer: Enter a whole number greater than zero.

abort.already_configured: Pico Link is already configured. Open its settings to manage your remotes.
abort.yaml_selected: To use YAML, set config_method: yaml under pico_link in configuration.yaml (or inside the included pico_link.yaml file), then restart Home Assistant. No UI entry is needed. To switch to the UI later, set config_method: ui, restart, and open Pico Link setup to import your settings.
